title: Noob Found Creative Mode

noob.caption: #FFD23F
noob.acting: bright, fast, cheerful cartoon character, impulsive and oblivious, great comic timing

steve.caption: #3FE0D0
steve.acting: calm, low, dry and deadpan; a practical survivor who rarely raises his voice

patch.caption: #B6F0FF
patch.acting: calm, literal, slightly too quiet; announces disasters politely

movie_note: Movie Episode 5 (the creator's notes, 2026-11-27; story/movie/ep05_shots.md): picks up Ep4's twist; the third poke pours the cube into a BTools hammer (shown on screen: 'Since the block!'); duck, statue, castle, door (room for the gag); one erase rule for every deletion; the duck, the castle, the statue, then the original course; REALITY 85 -> 82 -> 80 -> 77 -> 75 -> 73 -> 71, one drop per erasure; the dragon glitches but stays (Ep6 erases it), the door stays (Ep6 erases it). The original takes for the original lines (movie/ep05_published); a new take only for Patch's added 'Wait- don't-'.

music.note: Ep4's last cue goes on (the same seed, level and fallen note), dying as the cube implodes (gain matched to Ep4's last second at the cut: this chapter's master level is 3.5 dB lower)
the sandbox groove for the builds; out dead for the door gag, back for one bar, cut dead the frame the duck glitches
low unease under 'Where's my duck?' and Patch
a faint low drone left in the void, carried into Ep6

ambience.note: the world emptied: raw void wind

sfx.note: Ep4's cube hum goes on, faint
the finger lands: no zap this time
the cube pouring into his hand
the hammer forms in his fist
the statue lands: concrete boom, dust
high-altitude wind through the doorway, under the stare
the rising low tension, no melody, cut dead
the stepping stone and the checkpoint

stutters.note: the instant the duck is gone: 0.15 s of dead air

events.note: Ep4's last instant goes on: the Noob stunned on the blue terrace, Patch facing him (eye dim), Steve on the grey pad's edge, the 1.45 m glitch cube crackling at the terrace's front corner, the sealed dragon in the sky; silence, the low swell still ringing. The Noob blinks, then his eyes slide sideways to the cube
zero impulse control: he turns to the cube and reaches out a finger; Patch's eye snaps wide

events.name: patch_wait
events.note: added line (the creator's blueprint): Patch, too late; the poke cuts him off
the third poke: the finger lands on the cube; a pink flash, and this time no zap

the cube implodes inward: it folds into a stream of magenta-cyan code that pours into the Noob's hand and condenses into a glowing BTools hammer (white head, cyan rim); the hum dies; the tether is gone; REALITY stays at 85
he stares at the hammer in his fist, then points it at the white spawn plate next to Steve: a cyan selection box snaps round it

BTools materialize (8 frames): the box locks, a cyan scan plane sweeps up, a giant yellow rubber duck pops in with a 1.04 -> 1.0 bounce and square dust puffs; Steve jumps half a step back; the duck quacks

events.name: noob_build
events.direction_text: [thrilled, shouting with joy] I can BUILD stuff!
events.note: the original take; he forgets the lore bomb and beams, the hammer up
Steve lowers his pickaxe slowly, staring from the duck to the Noob

events.name: steve_since
events.note: the original take; flat, suspicious

events.name: noob_block
events.note: the original take; he lifts the glowing hammer proudly
he swings the hammer at the checkpoint pad east of the spawn: the selection box (sized to the statue, arms included), the scan, and a giant grey Noob statue slams down: a dust ring, a camera shake

events.name: noob_statue
events.note: the original take; arms wide, delighted
Steve's head tilts up 30 degrees to the statue's top; a 3-frame blink as his gaze drops to the Noob

events.name: steve_big
events.note: the original take; deadpan

events.name: noob_see
events.direction_text: [proud, beaming] So everyone can see me!
events.note: the original take; proud, beaming
a quick swing back over his shoulder: a pastel toy castle (towers, tiny flags) snaps onto the violet ledge behind him with a toy-brick clatter
Steve pinches the bridge of his nose, then points out at the open sky past the terrace

events.name: steve_home
events.direction_text: [dry, practical] Build us a way home.
events.note: the original take; dry
the Noob salutes
he swings at the terrace's front edge: the box, the scan, a single freestanding wooden door on a threshold sill (4 cm above the terrace), facing the open sky
he reaches over and pulls the handle: the door creaks wide open (hinge origin, local Z 0 -> 95 degrees, clear of the terrace) onto nothing: clouds and a long drop; the music drops out

events.name: noob_close
events.note: the original take; cheerful, presenting it
Steve's full deadpan stare through the open doorframe into the clouds; only the wind whistling through it
the groove comes back for a bar; then a soft glitch chime behind Steve pulls focus to the white plate
the erase rule (every erasure the same): the duck turns pink-and-black checkerboard top to bottom, slices into transparency, a few magenta pixels float up; the music cut dead; REALITY 85 -> 82

events.name: noob_duck
events.note: the original take; the smile gone, brows up and in (worry), only vowel mouth shapes
Patch darts forward over the empty white plate and aims his cyan scan cone straight down at it, where faint pink static still hangs; the Noob leans in, anxious

events.name: patch_delete
events.text: It's not you. Something is deleting what doesn't belong.
events.direction_text: [calm, quiet, serious] It's not you. Something is deleting what doesn't belong.
events.note: the original take; quiet; the cone sweeps the plate, then whips over to the castle just before it goes
behind the Noob the castle erases (the same rule); REALITY 82 -> 80; the low tension rises
over Steve's shoulder the giant statue erases top to bottom; REALITY 80 -> 77; the Noob steps toward it, both hands out, the hammer dipping

events.name: noob_no
events.note: the original take, pushed (presence +3 dB): real alarm

overhead the crystal-sealed dragon flickers violently into checkerboard and wireframe, a scanline tears across it, and it snaps back (still there: the next chapter takes it); the tension tone cut dead
hard silence; the camera settles on the original course west of the terrace (the yellow, green, orange, red and blue stones the four players ran off along)

one by one the stones erase, nearest first, then the orange stepping stone and the checkpoint east, and two far towers go with them; REALITY 77 -> 75 -> 73 -> 71; the sun pales, the sky turns cooler; only the grey pad, the blue terrace, the door and the dragon in the sky are left
the lonely wide two-shot; only the void wind; Steve staring at where the stones were

events.name: steve_us
events.note: the original take, closer and quieter (-3 dB); he turns his head slowly to the Noob and Patch, shoulders down, flat brow
hold: the three of them on two pads in the empty sky, the door standing open, the dragon above; the wind
